attestations.text: WANG Hua-chên 王化貞 (T. 肖乾, H. 乾山), d. 1632, Ming official, a native of Chu-ch'êng, Shantung, received his chin-shih degree in 1613, and started his career as a second class secretary in the Board of Revenue.
